mtunnel-path.statement: A Microtunnel is an end-to-end channel that is created on demand between Zscaler Client Connector and an internal application, through a Public or Private Service Edge and an App Connector.

quotes: A Microtunnel (M-Tunnel) is an end-to-end communication channel created between Zscaler Client Connector and an internal application via a Public Service Edge or Private Service Edge and an App Connector upon demand.

edges-enforce-policy.statement: Public Service Edges and Private Service Edges enforce user policies and provide secure transport to App Connectors.

quotes: Public Service Edges and Private Service Edges enforce user policies and provide secure transport to App Connectors.

ca-distributes.statement: The Central Authority provides a central location for software and database updates and for policy and configuration settings, and policy is distributed across all of its components.

quotes: The Private Access CA monitors the ZTE and provides a central location for software and database updates, as well as policy and configuration settings.
policy is distributed across all components of the CA.
